147:t_1:87.en:
???
「I don't intend to introduce myself. I only came to take a look at your face before I do my job.」

147:t_1:92.en:
???
「That thing just now... What an unusual power. It seems to be something different from a $$スフィア・アクト$$.」

147:t_1:93.en:
$n
「You... What did you do to me...!?」

147:t_1:94.en:
???
「As expected of 《$$いがみ合う双子$$》. Even after taking my $$スフィア・アクト$$, you're desperately trying to deny it in your heart.」

147:t_1:95.en:
???
「How absurd... Clinging to a faint memory inside yourself to try to deny your hatred.」

147:t_1:97.en:
???
「This meeting was more like a game. When my job is done, I'll play with you.」

147:t_1:98.en:
???
「Until then, struggle all you like, Reactor of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

147:t_1:103.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I had a bad feeling, so I came out into town... What on earth happened!?」

147:t_1:106.en:
$n
「Yes... That guy is the source of the unease we've been feeling...」

147:t_1:107.en:
$n
「He's a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$サイデリアル$$.」

147:t_1:113.en:
$$市民$$
「The leader of the $$黒の騎士団$$, $$ゼロ$$!」

147:t_1:114.en:
$$市民$$
「Because of you, this country got dragged into the war!」

147:t_1:115.en:
$$扇$$
「What are you talking about!? $$ゼロ$$ is...」

147:t_1:116.en:
$$黒の騎士団$$
「Shut up! Even under the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$'s rule, we'd have been fine if we could just live in peace!」

147:t_1:117.en:
$$市民$$
「But you trampled all over that! We will never forgive you!」

147:t_1:121.en:
$$スザク$$
「Stop it! What good does it do to vent your hatred in a place like this!」

147:t_1:122.en:
$$市民$$
「You're going to get in our way!?」

147:t_1:126.en:
$$藤堂$$
「We have no choice! Suppress them!」

147:t_1:127.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't use guns! Just incapacitate them, nothing more!」

147:t_1:129.en:
$$市民$$
「As if that would work on us!!」

147:t_1:131.en:
$$玉城$$
「What's with these guys!? Are they zombies or something!」

147:t_1:137.en:
$$扇$$
「You're going to save $$新日本$$, aren't you! I won't let you die in a place like this!!」

147:t_1:138.en:
$$扇$$
「This time, I'll believe in you to the very end! So!!」

147:t_1:139.en:
$$市民$$
「You're going to get in our way...!」

147:t_1:158.en:
$$スザク$$
「We don't know either... Some people suddenly showed up and started denouncing $$ゼロ$$...」

147:t_1:159.en:
$$玉城$$
「It makes no sense! They hurled their hatred at us with completely illogical excuses!」

147:t_1:160.en:
$$藤堂$$
「To stop that, $$ゼロ$$ had no choice but to...」

147:t_1:163.en:
$$スザク$$
「There was no other way... To stop them, taking their lives was the only option left...」

147:t_1:166.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The eyes of those who attacked me... They're the same as the eyes of people whose conflicting emotions were amplified by 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》 $$メオンサム$$.」

147:t_1:167.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Then they were being controlled by someone?」

147:t_1:168.en:
$$千葉$$
「In that case, everything is explained...!」

147:t_1:169.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This is only a guess, but the part of them that can't forgive me... Their hatred must have been amplified.」

147:t_1:170.en:
$$扇$$
「To think something like that is possible...」

147:t_1:172.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「No... Now that the $$ギアス嚮団$$ is gone, no new users can be born.」

147:t_1:173.en:
$$玉城$$
「Then what is it, damn it!?」

147:t_1:175.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「The problem is that someone with that power is in $$新日本$$ with malicious intent.」

147:t_1:176.en:
$$扇$$
「A power that amplifies hatred...! If someone used that on $$新日本$$ now...!」

147:t_1:177.en:
$$スザク$$
「People's hearts would grow even more desolate, and there would be no time to fight the Empire.」
